reader.requirement: At --std 85 a (report) file-name written in more than one USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR PROCEDURE statement of one Procedure Division must be refused (ERROR and EXCEPTION are synonyms, so one of each is still two); one statement naming the file twice, and a file named explicitly beside an OUTPUT or EXTEND declarative (GR4: only the explicit one applies) are legal and run one procedure.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses at 85 the 2002 USE formats 3/4 (EXCEPTION CONDITION / EXCEPTION OBJECT), USE without AFTER and USE without PROCEDURE

reader.edition-search: grep of DeclBindUse (ProcedureTableBuilder lines 1009-1130) for DialectLevel/Version/Construct: the _useFiles register and its Duplicate verdict have no edition condition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the file-name register; the USE formats around it differ (the 1985 Report Writer format has only file-name, OUTPUT, EXTEND).

reader.notes: A per-procedure-division operand register refuses a file-name repeated across USE statements and folds a repeat inside one statement; at run time the explicit-file declarative wins over OUTPUT. The diagnostics cite the 2023 clause only (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR3 (the RW text, not the Amendment-2 rewording of the I-O modules), XIII.4.8.4 GR4/GR5, and the Inter-Program USE GLOBAL precedence (§1985:X.5.5.4 GR1). Probes at --std 85: outer USE GLOBAL ON a GLOBAL report file plus a contained program's own USE ON it (refute-1985-09/c4/nested_global.cob) compiles; the inner OPEN failure runs only INNER (ST=30), the outer only OUTER: one procedure per request. USE GLOBAL ON RPT and USE ON RPT in one Procedure Division (global_and_local.cob) -> COBOL0897 (two explicit procedures). USE ON EXTEND beside USE ON RPT with OPEN EXTEND failing (file_and_extend_rw.cob) runs FILE only (ST=35), per GR4. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR3; OK §1985:XIII.4.8.4 GR4; OK §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1.
